sources: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234508 (BULL RIVER PAVILION, the only Bull River listing on recreation.gov)
https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/alerts (nothing for Bull River or Hwy 200), read 2026-10-22

values.note: 26 sites including one host site; two are pull-throughs.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bull-river-campground-and-group-site ('The campground has 26 sites including one host site, with tables and fire rings accommodating up to a 40' length RV. Two of the sites are pull-throughs.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: The Forest Service page's description lists potable water, but its amenity list says 'Potable water is not available at this site'; check before relying on it.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bull-river-campground-and-group-site ('Amenities include potable water, flush/vault toilets, reservable group site, and a fully developed boat launch with a dock'; amenity list: 'Flush toilet(s)', 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Seasons of Use from May 1; managed (fees, host) Memorial Day through Labor Day. The gate is closed December 1 to May 1 and may close earlier after heavy snow.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bull-river-campground-and-group-site ('Seasons of Use May 1', 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day. Campground gate is closed from December 1 to May 1, but may close earlier if we get a large amount of snow.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Only the group site (Bull River Pavilion: up to 100 people and 5 camping vehicles, 7-night maximum) is reservable, on recreation.gov or through the ranger station; the single sites are not on recreation.gov. Check-in/check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bull-river-campground-and-group-site ('reservable group site'; 'The Bull River Pavilion can be rented by the day and for overnight use ... www.recreation.gov'; 'Check-in/check-out 12:00 Noon') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/234508 (pavilion description, maxConsecutiveStay 7), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/bull-river-campground-and-group-site ('$16.00 daily fee per single site - 50% discount with US Golden Age/Access or Interagency Senior/Access Passes'), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai National Forest campground on Hwy 200 at the confluence of the Bull River and Clark Fork, adjacent to Cabinet Gorge Reservoir; developed boat launch with dock, open all year weather permitting. --Claude
summary: Forest Service page: confirmed 26 sites (incl. host) to 40 ft with 2 pull-throughs, flush/vault toilets, $16 single site (fees left as checked 2026-10-09), reservable group site with single sites FCFS. Added season (May 1 to the Dec 1 gate closure, managed Memorial Day-Labor Day), senior/access 50% discount. Potable water: the FS page contradicts itself (kept, noted). Note trimmed of restated values and the wrong 'Open ~Memorial Day to Labor Day'.
flags: Missing phone: Cabinet Ranger District, Trout Creek Ranger Station (406) 827-3533 (Forest Service page).
fees.nightly_high 150 is the group pavilion's 51+-person rate, not a single-site price (single site $16); left because fees were human-checked 2026-10-09.
